reason: A sibling write grant does not reach this agent.

name: permission-write-all
source:
on: pull_request_target
permissions: write-all
jobs:
  review:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
reason: Explicit write-all grants write capability.

name: fresh-owner

on: issue_comment
permissions:
  contents: write
jobs:
  review:
    if: github.event.comment.author_association == 'OWNER'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: gh pr view 1 --json title,body
      - uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
reason: A trusted commenter can trigger a fetch of another author's editable PR.
